name: Stash for Hidden Item Treasures (S.H.I.T.)
teaser: A custom 4x6 case which holds one of Fence's Collector task items.  Supports ODT's Softcore mod changes to Collector.
license_name: University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
description_html:
HUGE THANKS TO JEHREE, WITHOUT HIM THIS WOULDN’T BE POSSIBLE

This mod adds a custom case thanks to his “Custom Case Framework“ mod though slightly modified by him. This mod has been uploaded with his permission. Thank you

Keep your hard-earned treasures safe and secure with “S.H.I.T.,” the ultimate storage solution for any Tarkov collector. This custom-designed stash is specifically created to hold the rare and valuable items required for Fence’s “Collector” task, ensuring that your collection is always safe and organized. With custom-fit compartments for each item and a secure locking mechanism, “S.H.I.T.” is the perfect way to keep your treasures hidden from prying eyes. It is available for purchase at Therapist L2 and features slots instead of inventory cells. These slots have been filtered to only accept items required for Fence’s “Collector” task, making it easier for players to keep their stash organized. Additionally, for those running the “Softcore” mod, “S.H.I.T.” is compatible with the secure containers called “Gamma” and “Epsilon” as well. Don’t let your valuable items go unprotected - invest in “S.H.I.T.” today!

If you are receiving these errors:

TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading ‘Filter’) TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading ‘Filter’) at Mod.allowOrDisallowIntoCaseByParent (G:\SPT 3.5.5\user\mods\zStash for Hidden Item Treasures (S.H.I.T.)\src\mod.js:192:67) at Mod.allowIntoContainers (G:\SPT 3.5.5\user\mods\zStash for Hidden Item Treasures (S.H.I.T.)\src\mod.js:159:22) at Mod.postDBLoad (G:\SPT 3.5.5\user\mods\zStash for Hidden Item Treasures (S.H.I.T.)\src\mod.js:139:14) at PostDBModLoader.executeMods (C:\snapshot\project\obj\loaders\PostDBModLoader.js) at PostDBModLoader.onLoad (C:\snapshot\project\obj\loaders\PostDBModLoader.js) at App.load (C:\snapshot\project\obj\utils\App.js) TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading ‘Filter’) TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading ‘Filter’) at Mod.allowOrDisallowIntoCaseByParent (G:\SPT 3.5.5\user\mods\zStash for Hidden Item Treasures (S.H.I.T.)\src\mod.js:192:67) at Mod.allowIntoContainers (G:\SPT 3.5.5\user\mods\zStash for Hidden Item Treasures (S.H.I.T.)\src\mod.js:159:22) at Mod.postDBLoad (G:\SPT 3.5.5\user\mods\zStash for Hidden Item Treasures (S.H.I.T.)\src\mod.js:139:14) at PostDBModLoader.executeMods (C:\snapshot\project\obj\loaders\PostDBModLoader.js) at PostDBModLoader.onLoad (C:\snapshot\project\obj\loaders\PostDBModLoader.js) at App.load (C:\snapshot\project\obj\utils\App.js) then you are probably running SVM or another mod which changes filters on containers. For a temporary fix you can do one of the following:

  • Untick any “Remove Filter” options you have under Case Space Manager in SVM
  • Load SVM AFTER this mod

When Jehree has time to fix this issue in his Custom Case Framework mod, I will upload it as well. He is currently busy with other projects, but hang on tight.

Case asset made by Jehree as well

To install:
Drop it into your SPT folder

If you want to change the size of the S.H.I.T. case, you can do so in the config.

To change the background image of the slots, change “slot_bg”: “mod_equipment” in the config into one of these below.

  • mod_pistol_grip
  • mod_magazine
  • mod_reciever
  • mod_stock
  • mod_charge
  • patron_in_weapon
  • mod_barrel
  • mod_foregrip
  • mod_handguard
  • mod_mount
  • mod_scope
  • mod_tactical
  • mod_gasblock
  • mod_launcher
  • mod_sight_front
  • mod_sight_rear
  • mod_nvg
  • mod_equipment_000
  • mod_equipment_001

There might be some more which I haven’t found.

BEFORE UNINSTALL

Delete the case from your stash/inventory.
